issues.description: The problem statement and reference solution specify that construct_zero_state_prep_circuit should return a stim.Circuit, but the template function is annotated to return None. This creates a structural mismatch that can confuse students (documentation says a Circuit is returned) and may cause type-checking or expectation errors when students implement the function based on the spec.
